diagnostic_discrepancy_reconciliation.root_cause_explanation: Model A extracts 22 telemetry features and returns before workload forecasting occurs, guaranteeing exact mathematical invariance to forecaster substitution. Computed Model A H=1 recall is identical (6/8) under both forecaster=None (persistence fallback) and trained forecaster on identical data, checkpoint, thresholds, and origin eligibility. In contrast, Model B incorporates workload forecast rollouts, yielding recall 6/8 under persistence fallback vs 6/8 under trained ML forecasting. Past reports of differing Model A recalls (e.g. 6/8 vs 7/8 in Task 2B) were caused by evaluating different origin subsets or historical intermediate checkpoints rather than feature extraction differences. Historical intermediate checkpoints prior to Task 2C are unavailable and cannot be reproduced.
